summary: Craft your fantasy empire in this premium turn-based strategy RPG!
description: 🌟 A PREMIUM TURN-BASED STRATEGY EXPERIENCE Rule legendary factions and outsmart foes in simultaneous turn-based battles. Experience a premium, ad-free strategy RPG where your tactical genius builds an unstoppable fantasy empire. SpellForce: Heroes & Magic brings the critically acclaimed PC franchise to mobile with a completely fresh, standalone tactical angle. Enjoy a pure, story-free premium game focused entirely on deep, rewarding turn-based strategy. 👑 CRAFT YOUR FANTASY EMPIRE Expand your kingdom turn by turn in a 13-mission adventure mode, or conquer randomly generated maps in free play mode. Command Humans, Orcs, or Dark Elves, and force neutral factions to bend the knee. Harvest resources, claim mines, and build a flourishing fantasy empire. 🔮 EXPLORE DYNAMIC REALMS Command iconic heroes across dangerous lands to discover glorious treasures and essential resources. Every discovered city allows you to recruit unique units, expanding your tactical options for the battles ahead. ⚔️ MASTER SIMULTANEOUS COMBAT Outthink your enemy in brutal, simultaneous turn-based combat. Placed on tactical hex grids, your Archers, Knights, and Dark Elf Necromancers clash against terrifying beasts. You and your opponent plan moves at the exact same time—only the superior general will achieve victory. 🛡️ EVOLVE YOUR FIGHTERS (RPG MECHANICS) SpellForce: Heroes & Magic deeply integrates rewarding RPG mechanics. Equip magical swords and legendary armor to boost your hero's power. Level up your troops to unlock devastating skills, transforming raw recruits into elite warriors. PURE GAMING. NO GIMMICKS. ❌ No microtransactions ❌ No loot boxes ❌ No annoying ads ❌ No pay-to-win mechanics ✅ Just a massive, deep turn-based strategy adventure. ✨ GAME FEATURES: • Build Your Kingdom: Expand, explore, exploit, and exterminate in a deep 4X-inspired fantasy empire. • Lead Epic Heroes: Carry the battle directly to your opponents and strike them down. • Unleash Magic: Cast chain lightning, inflict terror, or heal your frontline using powerful spells. • Simultaneous Turns: Predict enemy movements and execute your grand tactics concurrently. • Deep RPG Progression: Loot items, distribute skill points, and level up your entire army. • 3 Playable Races: Command Orcs, Humans, and Dark Elves alongside their iconic champions. • 6 Neutral Factions: Ally with or destroy Gargoyles, Shadows, Dwarves, Barbarians, and Trolls. • Massive Roster: Muster over 30 unique units to dominate the hex-based battlefield. Supported languages: EN, FR, DE, JA, KO, PO, PT, RU, ZH-CN, ES, ZH-TW © THQ Nordic Mobile 2026
